normalized.answer: The 2002 GR3 and 2023 GR4 differ only in the apostrophe of record's (U+2019 in the 2002 text); the requirement is identical and GR-12.4.5.10.3-4 is the right pointer. The 2002 witness run stands.

definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 relative organization ('each record's logical position is uniquely identified by a relative record number') and §2023:D.2.2.2 describe the same structure, and GR3 itself states it in the same words in both, so the files governed are the same.
